sources.use: The behaviour specification this package implements. Nothing upstream was opened, decompiled or read to write this package.

The rights record the specification was written under, which clears code and behaviour, marks textures, models and sounds not-applicable, and leaves names unresolved. The unresolved names surface is why this package coins every declaration spelling and is not pack-compatible with the original; NOTES.md says so in as many words.
The whole of what this package names. It lists no other Ravel crate.
